reviews.text: I felt comfortable with both the educator Ilaria and Andrea. They were empathetic and pleasant people.

We couldn't be happier to have embarked on this journey with them! Since Tuono began his training journey, everything has truly changed. We've seen so many improvements and, above all, we've learned to understand each other and handle many situations completely differently.

A special thanks to Claudia, who is supporting us with incredible professionalism, patience, and dedication. She's a key figure for us, and we're truly happy to have her by our side on this journey.

A heartfelt thank you also to Andrea, for his expertise, availability, and passion for what he does.

You can sense the love and commitment behind this work.

Highly recommended to anyone looking to embark on a serious journey, supported by competent people who truly love their work. Thank you so much from us and from Tuono! ❤️
I believe that before training a dog, a person should be the first to be trained: letting your pets defecate and not picking up the result is a huge sign of rudeness and arrogance. Or not? 🤣🤣 …

We've completed a fantastic journey with our Thiago. It was a wonderful experience. We learned so much, and they taught us to understand our dog, giving him and, above all, us a sense of security. I want to thank everyone; we felt understood and pampered. Special thanks go to Ilaria, a sweet, patient, and, above all, very professional trainer who managed to transform our stubborn and fearful Thiago into a super obedient and cooperative dog. Now it's fantastic to walk with him and take him everywhere. Thanks for everything, even from our super dog.

I'm taking the dog handler course at Educanis. The course is held in the classroom and involves hands-on practice! The teachers, Andrea and Ilaria, are competent, professional, and even friendly. Like us, they love dogs, but they're teaching us how to truly respect them while keeping them, ourselves, other dogs, and other people safe. 👍😁

I'm taking the Dog Handler course at Educanis and my experience has been extremely positive.
The instructors proved to be highly knowledgeable, professional, and competent, sharing their knowledge with passion and clarity. I particularly appreciated the calm and welcoming atmosphere that was created during the lessons: while always maintaining a high level of professionalism, there were also moments of lightheartedness that made the learning experience even more enjoyable. Their extensive experience and preparation are clearly evident, and they're always available to answer questions and delve deeper into the topics covered. I highly recommend Educanis to anyone looking for serious training in the world of dog training in a stimulating and positive environment.
They also gave me the opportunity to bring my dog ​​for an assessment and I received valuable advice, professionalism, helpfulness, and even some welcome gifts for him.
Thanks again :)

Educanis' motto is "We don't train dogs, we educate humans"... and it's absolutely true. Andrea, Ilaria, and everyone who works there are highly experienced in the dog sector and work with professionalism, skill, and passion. My experience with them was top-notch. Highly recommended for all the services they offer.

Educanis is a welcoming environment, run by professionals who put love and passion into everything they do, offering a service that is always attentive to everyone.... I am very happy to have met Andrea and Ilaria who have filled my heart with so much love.
I came to learn about your services and I find them to be extremely professional, knowledgeable, and kind, as well as helpful. I absolutely recommend them without a doubt.

I discovered them by chance online while looking for a local trainer for my 4-month-old Jack Russell puppy. It was the perfect choice! We're only at the beginning of the journey, but the dog has already made a lot of progress. More importantly, they've opened our eyes to how many small mistakes we make, unintentionally, that can lead to various problems, more or less serious, for our dogs. Everyone is extremely knowledgeable. Ilaria, our trainer, is always super available, even remotely via WhatsApp, always giving us tips on things we might notice and film during the week.

They've only recently opened, but I'm sure they'll become a point of reference here in Rome.
The option of leaving dogs in daycare is also excellent, with various package and subscription options.
What can I say? Highly recommended!
I highly recommend this dog daycare! The staff is incredibly knowledgeable! Congratulations!

Top dog daycare!!! We have a great experience, and our Labrador is so happy when we arrive and leave him there for a few hours. When we pick him up, we sometimes find him sleeping soundly, a sign of great trust and that he's comfortable in the environment. The staff is very empathetic with both animals and people, and this is already an excellent starting point.
I recommend it without a doubt!

I was very happy with the hours, prices, the location where the dogs are kept (both inside and outside), and especially with the trainers.
Claudia is extremely knowledgeable and super kind.
Highly recommended.

I spent time with Corrado, my dachshund, at the new Educanis facility on Via Salaria and found great professionalism and, above all, respect and love for our four-legged friends. Highly recommended for both training and daycare.
It is a vibrant, magical place that always offers fascinating views

A charming place, it looks like an abandoned industrial warehouse, also home to a theater where I saw a beautiful production of Richard III. The only downside is the toilet area, which is poorly maintained.
